advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconcile the pre-feature SNAPSHOT phase bootstrap with the transition-derived live-fold rule (or re-derive phase from the retained raw STATUS history) so backfilled phases match the true lifecycle.
evidence: _processors.py:32-37 live fold: `if target_status == "in_progress": state["plan_review_phase"] = "execution"` / `elif target_status == "open": state["plan_review_phase"] = "planning"` — other statuses preserve the prior value
_processors.py:686 bootstrap: `phase = "planning" if status in ("open", "idea") else "execution"` — derived from current status, not transition history

tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py:31-33 confirms blocked preserves execution live; tests/unit/test_plan_review_phase_reducer.py:53-56 confirms bootstrap maps closed→execution regardless of whether the ticket ever entered in_progress
docs/plan-review-gate.md:443 acknowledges 'historical phase precision loss'
advisory.finding: The pre-feature SNAPSHOT `plan_review_phase` bootstrap derives the phase from the current compiled status alone (open/idea→planning, else→execution), which diverges from the live STATUS-folding rule that derives phase from the transition history (blocked/closed preserve the prior projection). A ticket compacted pre-feature after open→blocked or open→closed (never in_progress) will be backfilled as `execution` when its true transition-derived phase is `planning`.
scenarios: A ticket that transitioned open→blocked (or open→closed) before this feature and was compacted; its pre-feature SNAPSHOT is read and bootstrapped to `execution` though its true phase is `planning`, raising the blocking floor to 0.80 for a planning-phase ticket.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a `SNAPSHOT_STALE_PHASE` fsck check + `--repair-snapshots` re-derivation (mirroring SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL) so pre-feature snapshots can recover the true transition-derived phase from retained STATUS events.
evidence: fsck.py:276-284 only flags `creation_channel`: `if isinstance(_compiled, dict) and "creation_channel" not in _compiled and _has_retired_create(ticket_dir): out.append(f"SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL: ...")` — no equivalent `plan_review_phase` branch
compact.py:446 `compiled_state = reduce_ticket(ticket_dir, include_retired=True)` shows full-log rebuild replays retired sources and could re-derive the true phase
docs/concurrency.md:256-272 documents the creation_channel lossless-recovery contract (fsck SNAPSHOT_STALE_CHANNEL + --repair-snapshots) that has no plan_review_phase analog

docs/plan-review-gate.md:440-443 frames precision loss as only occurring when compaction was not paused, but a pre-feature snapshot already on disk is bootstrapped lossily on read regardless of any pause
advisory.finding: The `plan_review_phase` bootstrap migration lacks the detect-and-repair path its sibling `creation_channel` migration has: there is no `SNAPSHOT_STALE_PHASE` fsck check and no `--repair-snapshots` re-derivation, even though a full-log rebuild (reduce_ticket include_retired=True) over retained raw STATUS events could recover the exact phase. The lossy status-based approximation is therefore permanent for pre-feature snapshots with no reversal/recovery, breaking up/down migration symmetry with the documented lossless-recovery precedent.
scenarios: Operator upgrades to v7 over a store with pre-feature snapshots; the approximated phases can never be detected or repaired back to their true transition-derived values, unlike creation_channel which fsck flags and rebuilds.
